how: We read the website of every Raleigh-Durham wedding videographer listed on Lazo (66 listings, 59 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: photo booth rentals, a venue, a studio rental, a coastal lifestyle photographer, a production company's intern page, and photographers whose sites never mention video. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is audio from the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
Summer storms roll through the Triangle most afternoons. What happens to drone footage and the outdoor ceremony plan if it rains?

picks.name: Truffle Wedding Films | Photo + Video
picks.blurb: Avéline, listed as Truffle Wedding Films, shoots candid wedding video and photography as one team, delivers the gallery and films two weeks after the wedding, and lets you choose the music. The crew that shoots your engagement session is the crew on the wedding day. Raleigh, Charlotte, Charleston, Greenville and Dallas.

picks.name: Maadhurya Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: Maadhurya in Cary makes cinematic highlight films for Indian weddings, from Mehendi and Nikkah through the reception, and offers live streaming video for guests who cannot travel. Photography comes from the same studio, and the site shows named couples' teaser films.

picks.name: Live View Studios
picks.blurb: Live View Studios promises your wedding day, but it feels like a movie: luxury film-style photography and videography from a husband-and-wife team in Fuquay-Varina with a second base in Charleston. Real, nostalgic and timeless is the stated aim, across the Carolinas and the East Coast.

picks.name: Pixel 6 Studio
picks.blurb: Pixel 6 Studio specializes in Indian and South Asian weddings, with a team that says it knows every ritual and films and photographs them in a blend of candid and directed, editorial storytelling. Based in Holly Springs, with work from the Biltmore Estate to Washington, D.C.

picks.name: Sea to Summit Films // Cinematic Wedding Videography
picks.blurb: Josh and Cori, married since 2014 and parents of two boys, make handcrafted wedding films for adventurous couples who do not want a cookie-cutter video. Based near Raleigh in Selma, they film traditional ceremonies, elopements and destinations, mountains to beaches.

picks.name: Raleigh Wedding DJ and Video
picks.blurb: James and Amanda run Raleigh Wedding DJ and Video on the principle that you should know exactly what entertainment costs before you sign a contract. Wedding video services start at $795, and the same company prints a 4-hour DJ reception at $720 as a spring 2027 offer.

picks.name: Twenty-One Films
picks.blurb: A small Raleigh production company whose filmmaking is unobtrusive and whose storytelling is personal, inspired by the overlooked moment: a groom reading a handwritten letter, a father's glance on the walk down the aisle. Twenty-One Films has been making wedding films since 2009.

picks.name: AO&JO Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: Adrian and Jennifer Outlaw are a husband-and-wife photography and videography team in Knightdale: he is the cinematographer and editor, she the photographer and storyteller, with their sons as second shooters in training. Their weddings have been published, and the aim is raw, authentic seasons of life.

picks.name: IC Weddings LLC
picks.blurb: IC Weddings makes documentary-style wedding films that slow the day down and catch the moments the couple did not see happen, with editing matched to each couple's vibe. Raleigh-based, with packages for coverage from start to finish laid out on the site.

picks.name: 101 Studio llc
picks.blurb: Martin and Vivian, happily married since 2007, are 101 Studio, a Raleigh photographer-and-videographer couple making storytelling films and images. They describe themselves as easy and fun going, and the gallery is there so you can check the editing style before you book.

picks.name: Mirage Media & Video
picks.blurb: Mirage Media and Video is a Raleigh videographer whose owner grew up the eldest daughter of a big family and built the business on listening. Wedding filming leads the services, with corporate branding alongside, and she also covers Charlotte, Philadelphia, Atlanta and destination events.
